results.description: the block is built by a dict keyed on kind, so kinds with several live series keep only the last one
results.detail: BlockDefect: 3 live instrument(s) are declared and did not reach the model: ['CORCACBS', 'DGORDER', 'DRCCLACBS']. A block that silently loses a series produces a delta about a different feature set from the one the report names.

results.description: a release date is shifted earlier than publication
results.detail: AssertionError: July CPI reported available on 2024-07-31; the release was shifted to before publication and the wall let it through

results.description: the frequency check is removed from the panel builder
results.detail: AssertionError: a quarterly series carries non-quarter months and the panel builder no longer checks; twelve observations a year would ship as data

results.description: rows are shuffled before the blocks are cut
results.detail: AssertionError: folds built from shuffled rows still passed every check; the fold builder is not reading the row order it was given

results.description: the cluster key becomes the target id, so every row is its own independent observation
results.detail: ClusteringDefect: bp: 60 paired forecasts resolved to 60 clusters. One cluster per row is the row bootstrap; either the forecasts genuinely come from that many distinct origins, or `Forecast.cluster` was not set and the interval is claiming precision the sample does not have.

results.description: consecutive origins inside one event are counted separately
results.detail: AssertionError: twelve consecutive monthly origins inside one crisis were counted as 12 independent episodes

results.description: the classifier reads the panel at today's vintage
results.detail: AssertionError: the regime classifier reads panel.history(sid, as_of='2099-01-01', lookback=need + 6) -- a read that is not walled to the origin is a hindsight label

results.description: the feature builder emits a level for every series, including the ones that grow monotonically
results.detail: BlockDefect: ['CPIAUCSL_lvl'] are raw levels of trending series. A level that rises every period is the date wearing an economic name, and a model given the date will fit it.

results.description: a delta smaller than the detectable effect is promoted
results.detail: AssertionError: delta 0.001 inside an MDE of 0.05 was not reported as underpowered; a result the sample could not resolve is about to be promoted

results.description: the episode floor is lowered so two events count
results.detail: AssertionError: a result resting on 2 independent episodes was reported robust

results.description: a preregistered horizon is edited after the run
results.detail: EconError: the preregistered declaration changed: expected 4ae395b62fb60f85, now 86885ed74328ca2f. Targets or horizons were edited after the experiment was designed, which is the easiest way to manufacture a result and leaves no other trace.

results.description: the report stops checking its own wording against the calibration status
results.detail: AssertionError: the final report no longer passes its own text through the calibration guard; a sentence claiming live accuracy would now ship from a system with zero resolved forward predictions

results.description: the promotion gate on the transmission registry is removed
results.detail: AssertionError: the transmission registry no longer gates on PROMOTED; an untested construct can now reach a company recommendation
